## Description

Feature switches per tenant for the pregnancy, child growth and older-adult chart modules and for the patient-app trackers, off until the clinical review of growth charts, vaccine schedules and drug rules is signed. The console's pending list shows that clinical review.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each switch defaults off and is audited when changed.
- [ ] **AC2.** The chart and app hide a switched-off module and the server refuses its writes.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
